item.title: TBDBITL goes global for St. Patrick’s Day Parade in Dublin, Ireland
item.description: Ohio State’s marching band — best known as “The Best Damn Band in the Land,” or TBDBITL — is Ireland-bound for the spring break of a lifetime. item.description: Ohio State Provost Ravi Bellamkonda will take over the leadership of the university, replacing former President Walter “Ted” Carter Jr., effective Thursday.
